parts: CH. ZOTTELS HAPPILY EVER AFTER OF BIG-FOOT
(LONDON)
Male born on October 19, 2003. HD: A-A. Shoulder height: 64 cm. ACABE Sociability test: PASSED.
EUROPEAN CHAMPION 2004 IN PUPPY CLASS: EUROPEAN PROMISE 2004
CHAMPION OF THE CLUB 2004 ACABE
CHAMPION OF PORTUGAL, CHAMPION OF SPAIN, CHAMPION INTERNATIONAL
#20 in the official R.S.C.E. all-breed Dog of the Year ranking 2005
#1 in the official R.S.C.E. Bobtail breed ranking in Spain 2005
Qualified for Crufts 2006 and 2010
DNA-identified at the Real Sociedad Canina de España.

A dog from one of the world's Top breeders: Christina Bailey (ZOTTEL'S). He arrived at our home on December 22, 2003. We imported him from Great Britain to introduce the structure, bone, angulation and exceptional breed type of his bloodline into our line.

From the cross oflBobtail Top BIS winner at the Euro OES Show 2003 Reata's Class Two Thounsand and England's Top female in 2000 Zottel's Wildest Dream to bring together some of the best Bobtails in his bloodline through linebreeding. He is a nephew of the male who won RBIS at the Euro OES Show 2003 Reata's Como Las Condes and of the Multi BIS, European Champion 2005, BOB at Crufts 2006 multi Ch. Reata's Cosmopolitan (father of countless champions).
I thank his breeder Christina Bailey (of the kennel "Zottel's") for entrusting us with this fantastic dog and for the help she has given us.

His start in shows could not have been better, winning Best of Breed at the International Dog Show of Torrelavega 2004 at 5 months, and Best Puppy Male, Best of Breed and 2nd in Group at the European Dog Show of Barcelona 2004, earning the title of EUROPEAN PROMISE 2004, making him European Champion in Puppy Class. His report states that he is a very promising, high-quality puppy. At Medina de Pomar 2004 and Portugalete 2004, he won Best of Breed, Best in Group and 3rd in BIS. At the II National Breeding Show 2004, Judge Mrs. Jan Betts considered him the Club's best OES, with an impressive report, making him Club Champion for 2004.

On his first appearance in the ring in Open Class Male at the International Dog Show of Porto'05, he won CAC-QC, CACIB and Best Male, thus earning the obligatory point for the Portuguese championship.
At just 23 months, he completed his Spanish and Portuguese championships, as well as achieving several group podium places, and at 27 months he completed his International championship.
He is the father of our litters H, I and J.
He is the father of litter B at the kennel Ronda Sweet Dream, in which 8 puppies were born: 5 males and 3 females. The mother is Ch. Azahar Ronda Sweet Dream. December 31, 2007.
He is the father of litter A at the kennel Mozarrifar, in which 4 puppies were born: 2 males and 2 females. The mother is Foxy Lady de Krismaca. December 25, 2007.
